name: excalidrawer
description: Code-first Excalidraw diagram skills: flowchart, timeline, architecture, sequence. Generate hand-drawn-style diagrams and export to .excalidraw / SVG / PNG — no browser. Requires the excalidrawer-mcp server (npm i -g excalidrawer && claude mcp add excalidrawer -- excalidrawer-mcp).
